skill.description: Research Kuaishou competitor content through SocialDataX keyword searches, with traceable samples, bounded pagination, and evidence-based comparisons.

security_audit.summary: One finding confirms unpinned third-party package execution through npx; the other 37 alerts match benign formatting, service links, authentication documentation, or Chinese text. No evidence found of credential exfiltration, obfuscated payloads, or prompt injection in the supplied files. The external package implementation was not supplied, so its runtime behavior remains unverified.

remediation.suggestion: Pin an audited package version, verify package integrity, and require installation approval before execution with credentials.

content.value_statement: Comparing Kuaishou competitors requires relevant content samples and traceable evidence. This skill guides SocialDataX searches and organizes visible results into content angles and follow-up questions.
actual_capabilities: Guide Kuaishou keyword searches through the SocialDataX CLI or the corresponding MCP search tool.
Limit CLI searches by page count or item count and continue with returned pagination tokens.
Organize returned titles, authors, links, content identifiers, and visible engagement data when available.
Separate observed evidence from interpretations when comparing content angles.
Preserve partial results and resume searches within the original cumulative limits.
Handle missing dependencies, API errors, and insufficient balance using documented recovery steps.
limitations: Requires a SocialDataX API key, network access, and sufficient account balance.
The CLI requires Node.js and npm; the alternative MCP tool requires separate availability.
Search samples are not exhaustive, and returned fields or engagement data may be incomplete.
Provides research guidance, not a bundled data engine; the external CLI implementation is outside the supplied files.

use_cases.title: Compare brand content angles
use_cases.description: Search a shared category and compare visible competitor messaging while retaining supporting content links.

use_cases.title: Review creator positioning
use_cases.description: Collect bounded samples from a topic and identify recurring formats or angles for a roster review.

use_cases.title: Refine a publishing topic
use_cases.description: Review relevant search samples and develop follow-up questions before selecting a content direction.

prompt_templates.title: Find an initial sample
prompt_templates.prompt: Search Kuaishou for [topic]. Fetch one page and list available titles, authors, and source links.
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner: explore a topic with a small search.

prompt_templates.title: Compare competitor angles
prompt_templates.prompt: Search [category] with [competitor names]. Collect at most 20 results and compare content angles. Separate visible evidence from interpretation.
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: compare a bounded competitor sample.

prompt_templates.title: Build a traceable research brief
prompt_templates.prompt: Research [topic] across up to three pages and 30 results. Group content angles, retain source identifiers, and flag missing evidence.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: synthesize multiple pages without claiming full coverage.

prompt_templates.title: Resume an incomplete comparison
prompt_templates.prompt: Resume the interrupted [keyword] search using its saved cursor and original limits. Preserve prior results, subtract completed counts, and label remaining gaps.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: recover partial results without restarting or exceeding limits.

output_examples.input: Find a one-page sample about home workouts and identify possible content angles.
output: Illustrative format only; no live search was performed.
Sample entry: returned title, author, content identifier, source link, and visible metrics.
Observation: summarize only what the returned sample shows.
Interpretation: propose a possible angle and identify evidence needed to assess it.

output_examples.input: Continue a competitor search that stopped before reaching its original limit.
output: Illustrative recovery summary: keep previously collected samples and label the comparison incomplete.
Resume from the saved nonempty cursor with the original keyword.
Reduce remaining page and item allowances by completed counts.
When the cursor is absent, stop automatic recovery and report the unresolved gap.

best_practices: Start with one page, use focused keywords, and agree on page or item limits before expanding.
Retain source links and identifiers, and separate visible evidence from analytical judgments.
Review and pin the external CLI before execution, and keep API keys out of prompts and reports.
anti_patterns: Treating a small search sample as a complete market census or proof of competitor performance.
Restarting partial searches from page one, changing opaque cursors, or exceeding agreed collection limits.
Pasting API keys into conversations or authorizing unrelated installations and system changes.

faq.question: What can I search for?
faq.answer: Provide a keyword or topic direction. Brand names, audience terms, and scenarios can help focus the search.

faq.question: What setup is required?
faq.answer: Configure SOCIALDATAX_API_KEY for SocialDataX. The CLI needs Node.js and npm; the alternative MCP tool must be available separately.

faq.question: Can it retrieve every matching video?
faq.answer: No. Search has no stable complete boundary. Use page or item limits and treat results as a sample.

faq.question: Does it log in or modify my Kuaishou account?
faq.answer: The documented workflow is read-only and excludes login, posting, likes, comments, and account changes. The external package implementation was not supplied.

faq.question: What happens when account balance is insufficient?
faq.answer: Stop repeated retries and check the provider's billing dashboard. After funding, resume partial searches from their saved cursor within original limits.

faq.question: Is the external CLI version fixed?
faq.answer: No. The example uses @latest with automatic package approval. Review and pin an audited version before running it with credentials.
